TS001 no-recursion

A function does not call itself, so stack usage is bounded by the call graph rather than by the input.

languages: go javascript odin python rust typescript zig
severity: error
default: on
group: stable

TigerStyle: "Use only very simple, explicit control flow for clarity. Do not use recursion to ensure that all executions that should be bounded are bounded."
NASA P10 Rule 1: "Restrict all code to very simple control flow constructs — do not use goto statements, setjmp or longjmp constructs, and direct or indirect recursion."
